scored_items.title: Federal Reserve Board invites public comment on proposal that would allow U.S. banks and credit unions to use intermediaries to transfer funds through the FedNow Service
scored_items.probability_reasoning: The proposal is open for public comment, indicating a moderate chance of implementation.
scored_items.impact_reasoning: Allowing intermediaries could affect liquidity management and fund transfer processes.
